docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $4,742.95 FILED BY NGO, JOHNNY AS TO DEFENDANT BARRIENTOS, ANTONIO ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-23-2019 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
COPYING FEES (5 PAGE) PAID BY PLAINTIFF NGO, JOHNNY
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF - FEE FOR SERVICE $60.00 - SERVED NOV-13-2019, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT BARRIENTOS, ANTONIO

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF DEC-23-2019 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF DEC-23-2019 BY JUDGE PRO TEM: MICHELE MCGILL. PLAINTIFF JOHNNY NGO IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT ANTONIO BARRIENTOS IS PRESENT ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED SPANISH INTERPRETER CONCEPTION LOSANO. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: MICHELE MCGILL; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(506)
STIPULATION FOR CASE TO BE HEARD BY JUDGE PRO TEM. FILED BY NGO, JOHNNY BARRIENTOS, ANTONIO
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-23-2019 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF NGO, JOHNNY RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT BARRIENTOS, ANTONIO $4,792.95 PRINCIPAL, $110.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $4,902.95, COURT FINDS DEFENDANT MADE AN UNSAFE PASS AND COLLIDED WITH PLAINTIFF WHO HAD PULLED OUT OF PARKING SPACE INTO LANE OF TRAFFIC WHEN HIT. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED MAR-02-2020 ORDERED DESTROYED
